gates.name: audio-gate
gates.negative_control: none yet: with tone-source stopped the capture sees silence, which the gate refuses on the silent-packet count, but that arm is not wired as a control
gates.notes: the tone carries a different frequency per channel so channel order and content are provable, which a frame count cannot do
gates.proves: WASAPI loopback delivers a known format and cadence with every frame accounted for by device position

gates.name: codec-gate
gates.negative_control: none yet: an arm at a frame duration Opus does not permit is refused by the probe, which is a different thing from a gate arm
gates.notes: runs entirely on the Mac; libopus vendors C so nothing here cross-checks for Windows
gates.proves: Opus round-trips the tone with the sample count exact, and what a 5 ms frame costs against a 10 ms one

gates.name: audio-rtp-gate
gates.negative_control: none yet
gates.notes: the radio arm needs a second endpoint and declares itself unavailable rather than sending to this machine's own address, which the kernel puts on loopback
gates.proves: one Opus frame is one datagram and the RTP timestamp counts samples exactly

gates.name: jitter-gate
gates.negative_control: the loss arm: it must show concealment happening, and a loss arm with nothing concealed fails rather than passes
gates.notes: the ceiling cannot be exercised by a delay - only a sink slower than its source can breach it, which is A7
gates.proves: the jitter buffer conceals rather than stalling and never grows past its ceiling under loss, a stall and churn

gates.name: render-gate
gates.negative_control: the producer at default priority: it underran ten times in three hundred seconds, and that arrangement is what the promoted one has to beat
gates.notes: five minutes because a twenty second run called the broken arrangement clean two times out of three
gates.proves: a ring buffer feeds CoreAudio for five minutes with nothing unfilled, nothing overwritten and nothing missing

gates.name: audio-e2e-gate
gates.negative_control: the broken-link arm: udp-fault holds every datagram for 400 ms every 2 s, forty times the jitter target, so what arrives is past its moment and continuity breaks. The arm must fail, and the gate fails if it passes
gates.notes: the deciding counter is continuity, samples expected against played, because concealment counts as played and an underrun does not - a run whose underruns are zero because the concealer ran throughout carried nothing. The sender runs in the interactive session through win-session.sh since session 0 has no audio endpoints, and it is built on the host because libopus needs the cmake inside BuildTools. Refuses rather than reports when the host, the radio, the endpoint, the output device or an envelope is missing
gates.proves: Windows loopback to Opus to RTP to the jitter buffer to CoreAudio holds continuous audio over a minute and over ten

gates.name: e2e-gate
gates.negative_control: the fixture parameter set: a decoder configured from anything but the encoder's own parameter sets rejects real slices, so that arm must fail
gates.notes: REQUIRE_CLEAN_DISPLAY=0 makes it a link experiment and its presentation figures then mean nothing; LINK_ONLY=1 drops the renderer entirely
gates.proves: capture to NVENC to RTP to VideoToolbox to Metal, with delivery and presentation accounted separately

gates.name: phase-sign
gates.negative_control: a run where the shift never reached the producer: the step is absent and the gate refuses instead of reading the drift as a direction
gates.notes: finds the step in the series rather than comparing the ends of a run, because the drift sweeps a period every few hundred seconds
gates.proves: which way a known shift moves the phase between a source's frame and the viewer's refresh

gates.name: latency-gate

gates.notes: the launch order decides whether the measurement means anything; the injector must be up before the target takes the foreground
gates.proves: the software latency of the loop by segment, each interval local to one machine

gates.human_attention: the keyboard arm needs a text window in the foreground on the host; a device touched during a run makes the generator comparison unavailable rather than failed
gates.name: input-gate
gates.negative_control: a dry run: the injector counts without calling SendInput, so the host-side injection count must be zero
gates.proves: a generator's motion or keys reach the host exactly, compared against what it injected

gates.name: input-capture-gate
gates.negative_control: none yet, though the barrier is checked in both directions: events before it refused and events after it accepted
gates.notes: synthetic by default; REMOTE=1 injects for real
gates.proves: nothing leaks across a capture boundary and nothing is left held

gates.name: input-safety-gate
gates.negative_control: the killed arm: a client that vanishes mid-stream must still leave nothing held, and it is checked apart from the graceful arm rather than summed with it
gates.notes: the one harness here that had two arms from the start, and the only one that never produced a false pass
gates.proves: the whole input set survives a link that misbehaves, and a client that vanishes releases everything

gates.name: input-fault-sweep
gates.negative_control: each arm is its own control: an arm that reports nothing abandoned and nothing held while the injector dropped datagrams is a pass that has to be explained
gates.proves: reliable input survives loss, duplication, reordering and stalls across eight seeded arms

gates.name: game-input-test
gates.negative_control: not applicable
gates.notes: the only harness whose most important result is not a number; a person plays and says
gates.proves: a real game receives the input, and whether it feels right

status.why: a person has to be at the machine; no probe can stand in for one

gates.name: cadence-isolation
gates.negative_control: the contended arm: the same wedge, the same timeout and the same filler sent from the producer's own thread rather than from a thread of its own, which is the arrangement this design rejected and which must break the bound the isolated arm holds
gates.notes: this was a unit test until a three-core runner failed it, which made it a claim about whichever machine ran the suite; the arms are still tests and still in the transport crate, ignored so that `cargo test -- --ignored` runs exactly them, and a run whose quiet half could not hold 120 Hz is refused here rather than failed there
gates.proves: a control connection wedged until its writes time out costs a 120 Hz producer nothing it can spend
